title: Toasts
description: Trigger toast notifications — success, warning, error, and info variants.

tool.name: mount_toasts
tool.description: Mount a toast/notification demo on the canvas. Use when the user asks about transient notifications, alerts, success/error feedback, or imperative messaging.

parameters.position: top-right | top-center | top-left | bottom-right | bottom-center | bottom-left

props.name: position
props.desc: Where toasts stack on the screen

props.name: duration
props.desc: Auto-dismiss timeout in ms (0 to keep open)

props.name: max
props.desc: Maximum visible toasts before older ones drop

events.name: ondismiss
events.desc: Fires when a toast is dismissed (manual or auto)

attrs.desc: Individual toast (carries data-kind: success / warning / error / info)
